evidence_category: Lean kernel-compiled mathematical implication, with an unconditional ground-state existence/factorial consequence under the explicit charge hypotheses. Independent semantic review is additional evidence, not a proof replacement.
limitations: This endpoint provides local weak weighted L2 factorial bounds. A smooth or analytic pointwise representative theorem and quantitative KS descent remain separate obligations.
The constants and representative are existential mathematical objects; this theorem alone is not an executable certified energy algorithm or an evaluation of those constants.

Exterior estimates, collision compatibility for a global construction, the exact trial dictionary, global H2 approximation, physical residual certificates, finite rational solver, termination and operational bit complexity are not established by these two wrapper modules.
The explicit charge condition is Z>0 and 32<9*Z^2; a wider charge range is not asserted.
No claim that full Theorem T or Rung 2 is complete is supported by this bounded result.
